name: lookie-action
description: GitHub Action that triggers a Lookie review on a pull request.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --legal-comments=none --outfile=dist/index.js "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && git diff --exit-code dist
